# figure 

Declarative, backend-independent specification of a publication figure rendered from TVBO result containers. A Figure is a mosaic of Panels; grammar panels (cartesian/heatmap) bind container fields to visual channels via mark + encoding, while custom and image panels are peer escape-hatch kinds. Data binding (Layer.used) is a DataRef — the shared cross-container reference primitive (defined in common, reused here and by Argument.used / Parameter.used) — and doubles as the PROV provenance edge. It reuses shared slots/classes (name, description, label, iri, Provenance, Argument, DataRef); those resolve in the merged schema because this file is generated only as part of tvbo_datamodel.yaml, which imports it (so it does not import tvbo_datamodel back, avoiding a cycle).

URI: https://w3id.org/tvbo/figure
